component.name: Astrovia: Sky Atlas
component.summary: Open-source sky atlas for exploring the universe

description.p: Astrovia is a free and open-source sky atlas. Browse images of any part of the sky, overlay astronomical catalogues and query SIMBAD and VizieR, all in one fast, dark interface.

ul.li: Progressive HiPS surveys: DSS, PanSTARRS, SDSS, 2MASS, GALEX, Gaia and thousands more
Search objects by name or position, with SIMBAD and VizieR catalogue overlays
Open local FITS images, VOTable catalogues and MOC coverage files
Multi-view layouts, coordinate grids, contours, pixel tools and more
No accounts, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking

description.p: Astrovia is an independent community project based on the Aladin Sky Atlas developed by the Centre de Donnees astronomiques de Strasbourg (CDS). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the CDS.

screenshot.caption: Download HiPS surveys for offline use

ul.li: Planetary data (Solar system: Mars, Moon and more) now shown by default in Available data
Shared code between the Android and desktop apps, FITS .gz files, clear-cache command and sturdier builds
Image processing, field overview of the archives, light curves, gallery and many fixes
New Archives window: search about 100 mission archives and catalogues (JWST, HST, XMM-Newton, Gaia, eROSITA...) around the current view
Solar-system objects in the field, exoplanets, alerts, visibility windows, target lists and publications
Capture only the sky picture of the view at high resolution, in a folder you choose
Support for galactic and planetary surveys and for FITS tiles
Safer HiPS and catalogue downloads, with a size estimate and an option to download only the area in view
Fixed unreadable dialogs and server windows in the dark theme
Corrected the wording of the "already loaded" prompt

description.p: First Astrovia release for Linux, Windows and Android.
